- **FANCL** (UniProt: [Q9NW38](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9NW38)):
  - Length: 281 amino acids
  - Molecular weight: 32,179 Da (~**32.18 kDa**)

- **MAS1** (UniProt: [P04201](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P04201)):

  - Molecular weight: 37,465 Da (~**37.47 kDa**)

Comparing the two, the protein encoded by **MAS1** (37.47 kDa) is heavier than the protein encoded by **FANCL** (32.18 kDa).
